description:
Just a short distance from the city centre, this spacious self-contained apartment combines comfortable living with everyday convenience. Inside, you'll find two good-sized double bedrooms, a bright living and dining room, a practical kitchen, and a family bathroom.

The property also benefits from private gardens to both the front and rear, creating peaceful outdoor spaces to enjoy throughout the year. A garage, accessed from the rear lane, provides secure parking and valuable storage space.

With supermarkets, local amenities, and the M6 motorway all within easy reach, this well-located apartment is perfectly suited to those looking for a convenient and comfortable place to call home.

Directions Leave Carlisle heading east on Warwick Road (A69), pass St Aidans Church on the left and the property can be found on the left hand side.

Services Services: Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking • The ground floor area flooded in 2005; the environment agency has since spent 8 million on flood defences in the area.
